race.comment: PORTSMOUTH (4) has led for home at his last three runs but been nailed each time, most recently over 2130m at Goulburn. Very fit gelding who wears pacifiers for the first time. Coming back in trip with the gear change might do the trick. AUDACIOUSLY FRANK (12) is a promising stayer who got out late and drove hard but just missed over 1700m during the Grafton carnival. Still a maiden but out to this distance will give them plenty to think about. DYNAST KING (2) produced an eye-catcher at Warwick Farm recently, overcoming a slow start to power home and go under by less than a length at the end of a mile. Perfectly placed out to this trip at the third run back. EQUINOX LEGEND (3) won drawing away in a 1600m Kembla maiden 16 days ago. Coming along nicely and should enjoy getting beyond the mile for the first time. THE CRISTAL (10) is an honest mare who will be peaking at the fourth run back.
